name: Pi-hole
hook: A network-wide ad blocker that shields every device on your Wi-Fi — zero installs.
bullets: Blocks ads and trackers for the whole network
Runs on a Raspberry Pi or Docker in minutes
Dashboard shows what every device requests
setupSteps: Install Pi-hole on a Raspberry Pi, NAS, or Docker container
Point your router's DNS at the Pi-hole
Watch ads vanish on every device — TVs and IoT included
details: Pi-hole is a DNS sinkhole that blocks ads and trackers before they ever reach your devices — no browser extensions, no per-device setup. One install on a Raspberry Pi, NAS, or Docker container protects every phone, laptop, smart TV, and IoT gadget on your network. The dashboard shows live query stats, top blocked domains, and per-client history, with allow/blocklists you control. AdGuard Home is a close FOSS cousin if you prefer it.
setup: Raspberry Pi / Docker / any Linux box
